$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-spec-rendered-order.mjs (srs#801, X1). Same six pairs check-spec-readability.mjs's tree-order total already tracks in spec-readability-allowlist.json under reading-order-forward-reference (Type/Field assignment/AI guidance before Field; Note/Record before Semantic maturity tier; Relation before Instance), confirmed here to be genuine at the RENDERED position too, not just the computed tree position — the composition faithfully renders the tree order, so this check's residual violations are the same pre-existing structural debt, not a defect this unit introduced. P2 (Foundations reads in dependency order) and P3 (Instances) are the read-through's units that fold these. Entry shape: {pair:[sourceId,targetId], issue, note}. The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file is those units' job. Growing it needs an issue.

entries.note: "Type" (source) depends on "Field" (target) but Type renders first in Foundations. Same pair as spec-readability-allowlist.json's reading-order-forward-reference entry for these ids. Fold candidate: P2.
"Field assignment" depends on "Field" but is nested inside Type, rendering before Field. Same pair as spec-readability-allowlist.json. Fold candidate: P2.
"AI guidance" depends on "Field" but renders earlier in Foundations. Same pair as spec-readability-allowlist.json. Fold candidate: P2.
A second concept depending on "Field" ahead of its own introduction. Same pair as spec-readability-allowlist.json. Fold candidate: P2.
"Relation" depends on "Instance" but Relation (Part Structure) renders before Instance (Part Instances) in Part order. Same pair as spec-readability-allowlist.json. Fold candidate: P3/P4.
A third concept depending on "Field" ahead of its own introduction. Same pair as spec-readability-allowlist.json. Fold candidate: P2.
